annotations.title: Add a webhook to a form

description: Post this form's responses to an HTTPS endpoint. From the moment this succeeds every respondent answer leaves Fillo for a server Fillo does not control, so ASK THE HUMAN FIRST — name the exact host — and pass confirm=true only once they agree. Fillo signs every call, and the signing secret comes back in THIS RESPONSE ONLY; hand it to the human to store in a secret manager or environment variable and never commit it. Set includeAbandoned to also receive draft.abandoned events. Private and loopback addresses are refused. Needs webhooks:manage.

authentication.description: How Fillo authenticates to your endpoint: {"type":"none"}, or {"type":"bearer"|"x-api-key","secret":"…"}. The secret is stored encrypted and never returned.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

url.description: Public https:// endpoint to post to.
